verified: Schizophrenia often begins in late adolescence or early adulthood, typically between the mid‑teens and early thirties.

A substantial proportion of individuals with schizophrenia exhibit positive symptoms such as hallucinations and delusions, and many also display negative symptoms like social withdrawal and flat affect.
Having a first‑degree relative with schizophrenia is associated with a markedly increased risk compared with the general population.
Only a minority of people with schizophrenia in India receive continuous evidence‑based care, with estimates suggesting coverage may be around or below one‑third.
With early psychosocial support and medication adherence, many individuals achieve functional improvement within two years, though precise rates are not well documented.

research.hook: Did you know that 1 in 100 young adults in India will experience schizophrenia, yet most of us still think it’s just “hearing voices” from movies?
research.tip: Create a “3‑2‑1 Reset” grounding routine: name 3 things you see, 2 things you can touch, and take 1 deep breath whenever you feel overwhelmed.

scenes.text: Kya aap jaante hain schizophrenia sirf hallucinations nahi?
scenes.text_en: Did you know schizophrenia isn’t just hallucinations?
scenes.text_hi: क्या आप जानते हैं स्किज़ोफ़्रेनिया सिर्फ़ हॉलुसिनेशन्स नहीं?

scenes.text: College ya office mein stress hota, par ye alag hota.
scenes.text_en: College or office stress exists, but this is different.
scenes.text_hi: कॉलेज या ऑफिस में स्ट्रेस होता, पर ये अलग होता।

scenes.text: Ye disorder taur par late teens se early thirties tak aata.
scenes.text_en: It usually starts in late teens to early thirties.
scenes.text_hi: ये डिसऑर्डर तौर पर लेट टीन से अर्ली थर्टीज़ तक आता है।

scenes.text: Kuch log hallucinations, delusions dekhte, aur kuch social withdrawal bhi.
scenes.text_en: Some see hallucinations, delusions, others withdraw socially.
scenes.text_hi: कुछ लोग हॉलुसिनेशन्स, डिल्यूज़न्स देखते, और कुछ सोशल विड्रॉवल भी।

scenes.text: First-degree relative hone se risk kaafi badh jaata hai.
scenes.text_en: Having a close relative raises the risk a lot.
scenes.text_hi: फ़र्स्ट-डिग्री रिलेटिव होने से रिस्क काफी बढ़ जाता है।

scenes.text: India mein sirf ek‑third ya kam log continuous care lete hain.
scenes.text_en: In India, only about a third get continuous care.
scenes.text_hi: इंडिया में सिर्फ़ एक‑थर्ड या कम लोग कंटीन्यूअस केयर लेते हैं।

scenes.text: Shuruati support aur medication se do saal mein function behtar hota.
scenes.text_en: Early support and meds improve function within two years.
scenes.text_hi: शुरुआती सपोर्ट और मेडिकेशन से दो साल में फ़ंक्शन बेहतर होता।

scenes.text: Sahi madad se zindagi phir se khil sakti hai.
scenes.text_en: With proper help, life can flourish again.
scenes.text_hi: सही मदद से ज़िन्दगी फिर से खिल सकती है।

scenes.text: Aap bhi try kar sakte hain ek simple grounding technique.
scenes.text_en: You can try a simple grounding technique too.
scenes.text_hi: आप भी ट्राय कर सकते हैं एक सिम्पल ग्राउंडिंग टेक्निक।

scenes.text: Pehle 3 cheezein dekho, 2 chhoo, phir 1 gehri saans lo.
scenes.text_en: First see 3 things, touch 2, then take 1 deep breath.
scenes.text_hi: पहले 3 चीज़ें देखो, 2 छू, फिर 1 गहरी साँस लो।

scenes.text: Ye tip apne dost ko bhejo jo kabhi overwhelmed feel karta.
scenes.text_en: Send this tip to a friend who feels overwhelmed.
scenes.text_hi: ये टिप अपने दोस्त को भेजो जो कभी ओवरवेल्म्ड फील करता।
